errorExplanation.timeout: This means the analysis took too long. No changes were made; try again in a minute.
errorExplanation.invalidResponse: This means the AI returned an unexpected response format. No changes were made; try again.
errorExplanation.notConfigured: This means the AI service is not configured on the server yet.

historyCoverage: Current additions are included. Deleted-item history is collected from this AI release onward.
